display_long_description:
Welcome to Realize Music: Sing, a one-of-a-kind experience that will allow you to continuously express your passion for music in a range of private, secure, and intimate settings.




















[media]

# **❤️ Healing through music**  

Be the master of your own musical wonderscape in Sing. A joyful, judgment-free immersive sing-along journey that will encourage users to use their voices regularly for their own pleasure and benefit, regardless of whether they ever choose to sing in front of others.

[media]

# **🎨 Express your creativity**  

Realize Music: Sing lets you express yourself with a variety of 3D creative tools, such as splashing colors or playing sound-reactive drums in the middle of your favorite songs!

[media]

# **🌎 Ever-changing worlds**  

Explore a combination of unique environments depending on your song preference. A plethora of scenery is all available at your fingertips to enjoy alongside your most beloved songs. Be in the moment.

[media]

# **🎵 Largest music library**  

You will have access to the largest library ever provided in an interactive app or in any karaoke room, for that matter. With libraries so expansive that you can express yourself and sing along with your favorite artists, with brand-new songs to discover being released every week!

[media]

This app contains streamed content and requires a high quality internet connection. You may experience latency issues or discomfort if your connectivity is interrupted. Streamed content is provided by Realize Music Inc., and may not always be available.
